# Chetan Bhosale

Founding Engineer at [Linkrunner](https://www.linkrunner.io). Backend at [Respan](https://www.respan.ai) (YC W24).

Ex sales guy who learned to code. I sit with customers, work with design, and ship the whole thing, from the React screen down to Go services, Kafka, and ClickHouse.

Based in Bengaluru, India.

## Work

### Linkrunner (Founding Engineer, Oct 2025 to present)

Mobile measurement partner for growth teams: attribution, deep links, SKAN, and campaign analytics. $565K pre-seed led by Titan Capital, used by 100+ growth teams.

- Own the product loop end to end: sit on customer calls, shape scope in Figma with design, ship it, then own what happens after launch.
- Rebuilt the whole customer dashboard from 0 to 1 and migrated every account in 20 days.
- Own the SDK fleet on five platforms (Android, iOS, React Native, Flutter, Cordova) and built an SDK console that cut integration testing from 1 hour to 5 minutes.
- Moved analytics from Postgres to ClickHouse. Queries went from seconds to milliseconds and infra cost dropped by up to $8K a month.
- Helping break the Node.js monolith into Go microservices (gRPC, WAL-backed writes) now serving 25M+ requests a month.
- Moved event streaming from SQS to Kafka and helped move the infra from AWS to GCP.

### Respan (Backend Engineer)

YC W24 AI engineering platform (formerly Keywords AI). One gateway for 1,000+ models, with tracing, monitoring, and evals for AI agents. Handles 2T+ tokens and 1B+ logs a month.

- Backend engineer on the platform that sits between AI products and their LLM calls: gateway, tracing, and evals.
- Working on services used by teams like Retell AI, Mem0, Gumloop, and Lovable.

### Petpooja, via TransErg (Software Engineer, Jun 2024 to Sep 2025)

Restaurant tech platform serving 150K+ businesses. Joined TransErg and continued at Petpooja after the acquisition.

- Shipped the online ordering widget for restaurant and hotel chains, handling around 10K orders a day.
- Owned Petpooja Studio: 3M+ food images delivered to Zomato and Swiggy, cleaned and tagged by a self-hosted LLM pipeline.
- Moved services from hand-managed EC2 boxes to Docker and then EKS.

### Hire My Assistants (Sales, then Full-stack Engineer, Dec 2022 to Jun 2023)

Joined in sales and marketing, then moved to engineering once they found out I could code.

- Built the internal CRM used by 1,000+ realtors, straight from what I heard on sales calls.
- Built property listing pages serving around 100K visitors a day.

## Projects

- [Nakama](https://trynakama.com) (private beta): clone your prod stack into safe sandboxes with real masked data, for AI agents, security testing, and API testing.
- [keybro](https://github.com/ChetanBhosale/keybro) (macOS): menu bar app that puts Claude Code in any text field, with a local memory your sessions can share.
- [geo.repair](https://geo.repair) (live): AI crawler audit that clones your repo, applies the fixes, checks the build, and opens the PR.
- [CleanMac](https://github.com/ChetanBhosale/cleanmac) (macOS): native storage cleaner that finds what other cleaners miss and explains every file in plain words.
- [OmegleForTech](https://omeglefortech.com) (live): GitHub-verified 1:1 video chat for developers, peer to peer over WebRTC.
- [Dovia](https://dovia-delta.vercel.app) (building): prompt-to-app builder with multi-model routing, live preview, and one-click deploy.

## Stack

TypeScript, Go, Python, React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP.

## Education

BCA, St. Xavier's College, Ahmedabad (2021 to 2024).

## About

I started in sales, running campaigns for realtors. Then they found out I could code, and I started building the tools they kept asking for. Hearing the problem first and then shipping the fix is still how I work.

Outside work I make music, draw, game, cook, and plan the next trip. Martial arts is the longest running thread: I've won three national karate golds.
